items.title: 12.10 Observable (dikhne wale) universe ka zyada tar matter plasma hai (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.10 (PDF 274-275) in the book's order, with the correction, a table and a self-check.

blocks.text: Hamara universe (kaainat) hamari soch se kahin bara hai: hum is ke sirf 5% hisse ke bare mein jante hain aur baqi 95% ke bare mein nahi jante. Maslan universe ka taqreeban 27% unknown (na-maloom) matter hai jisay dark matter kehte hain, aur taqreeban 68% ek mysterious (raaz bhari) 'antigravity' cheez hai jisay dark energy kehte hain. 27% + 68% = 95%. Yani universe ke 95% ke bare mein hum kuch nahi jante.

Doosri taraf, jo 5% hum jante hain (ordinary yani aam matter), us ka zyada tar hissa hydrogen aur helium hai, aur yeh dono taqreeban plasma state (halat) mein hain: itne garam ke atoms se electrons alag ho jate hain aur charged particles ka mixture ban jata hai. Kitab ke hisaab se is 5% ka 95% plasma state mein hai aur baqi 5% doosri shakal mein. Is liye result yeh hai ke observable (dikhne wale) universe ka zyada tar matter plasma hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke maloom 5% mein 68% hydrogen, 27% helium aur 5% aam matter hai. Yeh 68%, 27% aur 5% to poore universe mein dark energy, dark matter aur aam matter ke hisse hain jo ghalti se dobara likh diye gaye; aam matter khud apna hissa nahi ho sakta. Sahi: aam matter taqreeban 74-75% hydrogen, 24% helium aur 1-2% bhaari elements hai (kitab ka apna topic 12.9 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium deta hai).

blocks.caption: Kitab ke mutabiq universe kis cheez se bana hai
rows: taqreeban 5%; zyada tar plasma state mein hydrogen aur helium

blocks.prompt: Observable (dikhne wale) universe ke zyada tar matter ko plasma kyun kaha ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar dikhne wala matter sitaron mein aur sitaron aur galaxies ke darmiyan garam gas mein hai. Un ki hydrogen aur helium itni garam hai ke un ke atoms free electrons aur nuclei mein toot jate hain (ionize ho jate hain), aur yahi plasma state hai; Zameen jaise aam solids, liquids aur neutral gases bohat chhota hissa hain.

items: Universe ka taqreeban 95% unknown hai: dark matter (taqreeban 27%) aur dark energy (taqreeban 68%). Maloom 5% mein hydrogen aur helium taqreeban sab plasma state mein hain, is liye dikhne wala zyada tar matter plasma hai.
